blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: For many people, discovering everything Tanzania has to offer is a dream. Whether it is an epic Tanzania safari to spot Africa’s Big Five, climbing Kilimanjaro or unwinding on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar, you will find it all in Tanzania. The good news: Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary that matches all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: Looking for inspiration? Our most popular itineraries are a good place to start. Most of our clients like to round off their exciting safari with a few relaxing days on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Does that appeal to you too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: You can pick from our popular Tanzania itineraries or have us shape the journey around you; either way, we are ready to help. Come along and prepare to explore Tanzania in your own time and in exactly the style you prefer!

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: Our Your Tanzania Trip guide is waiting for you when you land at Kilimanjaro International Airport. He takes you to your hotel so you can rest after your flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: Before the climb starts, you meet your guide for a briefing, with advice on clothing, packing and other useful tips to make the climb as comfortable as possible for you.

blocks.orig: Your adventure begins when your guide picks you up at your hotel and drives you for about two hours to the Rongai Gate. You then start this exciting adventure ascending through beautiful lush forests filled with diverse animal sounds. After a lunch break, you continue until the first camp on the Rongai route, which is on the less forested north side of the mountain. This quieter route gives you plenty of chances to spot different kinds of wildlife.
blocks.html: The adventure starts when your guide collects you from your hotel for a drive of about two hours to the Rongai Gate. From there you begin the climb through beautiful, lush forest full of all kinds of animal sounds. Following a lunch break, you carry on to the first camp of the Rongai route, on the north side of the mountain where there is less forest. As this route is quieter, you have lots of opportunities to see different types of wildlife.

blocks.orig: Today's hike takes 5-6 hours, starting with a steep climb where you might begin to feel the altitude as you catch your first glimpse of Kilimanjaro's Mawenzi Peak. After a while, you arrive at the first cave, where you have some time to explore. Lunch is taken in the second cave. In the afternoon, the climb gets less steep and you finish the hike towards the camp in a sheltered valley near Kikelewa or the third cave.
blocks.html: The walk today lasts 5-6 hours and opens with a steep climb, where the altitude may start to make itself felt as you get your first view of Kilimanjaro's Mawenzi Peak. After some time you reach the first cave, with time to look around. You have lunch at the second cave. In the afternoon the trail becomes less steep, and you end the day at the camp in a sheltered valley near Kikelewa or the third cave.

blocks.orig: Today, you can admire some breathtaking views as you continue your route through this steep hike. You walk for about 4-5 hours in the morning, to keep the afternoon and evening to rest and to give your body a chance to adapt to the altitude. You go until Mawenzi Tarn, where you spend the night. It is just below the Mawenzi summit, with amazing views of both Kilimanjaro peaks, Mawenzi and Kibo.
blocks.html: Today the steep hike rewards you with some breathtaking views along the way. You walk for roughly 4-5 hours in the morning, leaving the afternoon and evening free for rest so your body can get used to the altitude. Your destination is Mawenzi Tarn, where you stay overnight. It sits just below the Mawenzi summit and looks out on both of Kilimanjaro's peaks, Mawenzi and Kibo.

blocks.orig: On this 4th day on the mountain, be fascinated by the lunar landscape you come across on the way to the higher camp. Kibo Camp, located right below Kibo summit, offers spectacular views of the Kenyan plains. You walk for 5-6 hours through the alpine desert environment, then rest after lunch in the afternoon, as the next day is the summit push to the peak of Kilimanjaro!
blocks.html: On your 4th day on the mountain, the lunar landscape on the way to the higher camp will fascinate you. Kibo Camp lies right below the Kibo summit and has spectacular views over the Kenyan plains. You hike for 5-6 hours through alpine desert and rest in the afternoon after lunch, because tomorrow is the summit push to the top of Kilimanjaro!

blocks.orig: At midnight, you start the final summit push to Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa! Be prepared; it's about 12 hours of walking on this intense day. After reaching Gilman’s Point through a steep climb with your flashlight, Uhuru Peak is relatively easy to reach. Witness one of the most beautiful sunrises and celebrate your achievement, then head back down to the Kibo Huts Camp for a meal before continuing the descent to Horombo Huts for an overnight stay.
blocks.html: At midnight you set off on the final summit push to Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa! Be ready for an intense day of about 12 hours of walking. Once you have reached Gilman’s Point via a steep climb by the light of your flashlight, getting to Uhuru Peak is fairly easy. Watch one of the most beautiful sunrises and celebrate what you have achieved, then make your way back down to Kibo Huts Camp for a meal before you continue descending to Horombo Huts, where you spend the night.

blocks.orig: On this final day, you descend through a beautiful rainforest to the exit of Kilimanjaro National Park, the Marangu Gate. This is a delightful 5 to 6 hours walk at the end of which the whole group comes together to congratulate each other. Your driver then takes you back to your hotel where you get a well-deserved rest.
blocks.html: On the last day you walk down through a beautiful rainforest to the Marangu Gate, the exit of Kilimanjaro National Park. It is a lovely walk of 5 to 6 hours, and at the end the whole group gathers to congratulate one another. Your driver then brings you back to your hotel for a well-earned rest.

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately your holiday has come to an end and it is time to travel home. Make the most of your final hours in Tanzania until our driver collects you and brings you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Not ready to leave yet? You can also add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
